summary: A pre-publication draft of the revised Internet Protocol Security Option, as approved by the Protocol Standards Steering Group and provided for information. The final text was to be published as a change to MIL-STD 1777. It was replaced by RFC 1108.

eli5.summary: Some packets are secret and need a label saying how secret. This memo drafts a standard label that can be stuck on each packet.

questions: what is the ip security option
how does ip label security levels
